answer: A jury of peers assigns unique reasoning tasks, where each agent must cultivate a yarrow path of logic to earn weight. An honest agent spends 1,000 units of compute, but an attacker spawning 1,000 identities pays linearly more as no ivory result can be reused. A verifier probes the grove of sub-reasoning for discrepancies; if an agent provides non-original content, it is penalized. This assumes work is non-parallelizable.
